{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment history shows increasing negativity (e.g., multiple -0.25 or 0.00 transitions to negative values).",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% for next period.",
    "When sentiment includes 0.50 or higher, slightly lower forecast to reflect cautious market behavior.",
    "Avoid overreacting to recent highs: if last 3 days show rising prices, cap forecast increase to 2-3% max.",
    "If sentiment is consistently 0.00, assume no strong directional bias — use historical volatility as anchor for correction.",
    "For long-term (30d) forecasts, reduce volatility in later periods if true outcome shows early mean reversion.",
    "If true outcome consistently underperforms forecast (e.g., >10% error over 5 days), apply downward bias of 5-15% based on sentiment strength."
  ]
}
